# TikHub — Social Media API & Data Infrastructure Platform

## Overview

TikHub is a social media data infrastructure platform designed for developers, AI agents, researchers, and enterprises. It provides programmatic access to public data from 16 social media platforms through a unified API, along with pre-collected datasets for AI training, 990+ MCP tools for AI agents, and a real-time Live Room WebSocket API.

TikHub focuses on social data infrastructure for the AI era: social reasoning and emotional-intelligence datasets for physical AI, plus real-time social APIs powering AI-agent applications in quantitative trading, government & defense, and marketing. 30,000+ developers and data teams use TikHub; 300M+ requests are ingested daily. TikHub collects public data only and operates in alignment with GDPR and CCPA. TikHub supplies the tools and services that enable data access; it does not own, resell, or redistribute the underlying data itself.

## Platform Coverage

TikHub supports 16 social media platforms with 1,000+ API endpoints:

| Platform | Data Types | Key Endpoints |
|----------|-----------|---------------|
| TikTok | Videos, users, comments, search, live, trending, shop, ads, creator analytics | 6 API series: Web, App V3, Creator, Analytics, Shop, Ads |
| Douyin | Videos, users, comments, search, billboards, Xingtu creator marketplace | 6 API series: Web, App V3, Search, Billboard, Xingtu, Xigua |
| Xigua | Videos, users, comments, recommendations | App V2 API |
| Rednote (XHS / Xiaohongshu) | Notes, users, comments, search, trending, products | 4 API series: App, App V2, Web V2, Web V3 |
| Instagram | Posts, reels, stories, users, comments, search | 3 API series: V1, V2, V3 |
| Twitter/X | Tweets, users, replies, search, trending, lists | Web API |
| YouTube | Videos, channels, comments, search, playlists, shorts | 2 API series: Web, Web V2 |
| Threads | Posts, users, comments, search | Web API |
| LinkedIn | Profiles, experiences, skills, posts, companies, jobs, search | 2 API series: Web, Web V2 (43+ endpoints) |
| Reddit | Posts, comments, subreddits, users, search | App API |
| Bilibili | Videos, users, comments, danmaku, search | 2 API series: Web, App |
| Weibo | Posts, users, comments, hot topics, search | 3 API series: App, Web, Web V2 |
| Kuaishou | Videos, users, comments, live rooms, hot boards, rankings | 2 API series: Web, App |
| WeChat | Channels videos, Official Account (公众号) articles, read counts, comments | 2 API series: Channels, Official Account |
| Lemon8 | Posts, users, comments, search | Web API |
| Zhihu | Questions & answers, articles, users, topics | Web API |

## API Architecture

### Authentication
All API requests require an API key passed via the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

### Base URL
```
https://api.tikhub.io
```

### Rate Limits
- Default: 10 requests per second (RPS), free
- RPS plans: 20 RPS ($5/mo) up to 100 RPS ($55/mo)
- Enterprise: 100+ RPS, custom rate limits available

### Response Format
All endpoints return JSON with consistent structure:
```json
{
  "code": 200,
  "message": "success",
  "data": { ... }
}
```

## MCP Integration

TikHub provides 990+ Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools enabling AI agents to directly access social media data. Each platform has a dedicated MCP server at `https://mcp.tikhub.io/{platform}/mcp` (e.g. `/tiktok/mcp`, `/instagram/mcp`, `/youtube/mcp`). Discovery endpoint: `https://mcp.tikhub.io/platforms`. Health check: `https://mcp.tikhub.io/health`.

### Supported Clients
- Claude Desktop
- VS Code (with MCP extension)
- Cursor
- Cline, Cherry Studio
- LangChain / LangGraph
- Any MCP-compatible client

### Transport Methods
- Streamable HTTP (recommended)
- Server-Sent Events (SSE): `https://mcp.tikhub.io/{platform}/sse`

### Quick Setup (Claude Desktop)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "tikhub-tiktok": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "mcp-remote",
        "https://mcp.tikhub.io/tiktok/mcp",
        "--header",
        "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
Add one server entry per platform you need (tiktok, instagram, youtube, douyin, etc.).

## Datasets

Pre-collected social media datasets with 1B+ records:

- **Formats**: CSV, JSON, JSONL, Parquet
- **Quality**: Cleaned, deduplicated, licensed for commercial use
- **Update frequency**: Refreshed continuously
- **Use cases**: AI/ML training, RAG pipelines, fine-tuning, sentiment analysis, market research, academic studies
- **Pricing**: From $0.40 per 1K records at volume (tiers: 100K–500K records from $150; 20M+ records from $8,000)

## Live Room API

Real-time livestream data via WebSocket connection:
- Danmaku (live comments/chat)
- Gift events
- Likes and member events
- PK battle data
- Supported platforms: TikTok Live, Douyin Live
- Per-message pricing by category (e.g. chat messages, gifts, high-value conversion events)

## Browser Extension

TikHub Social Media Extension (Chrome): a bring-your-own-key side-panel analytics toolkit for TikTok, Douyin, Instagram, X, and Bilibili. Collect comments, analyze public accounts, and generate one-click AI-powered trend reports (interactive HTML + raw JSON/CSV export). Open the Chrome Web Store and search "TikHub". Requires a free TikHub API key.

## Marketplace (launching August 2026)

TikHub Marketplace opens August 2026: developers can list their own AI agents, APIs, and data connectors. 10% commission (vs. the ~20% industry standard) — sellers keep 90% of every sale. Early submissions are reviewed now via https://tikhub.io/contact.

## Pricing

### Pay-as-You-Go (Primary Model)
| Daily Volume (requests) | Price per Request |
|-------------------------|-------------------|
| 0 – 1,000 | $0.001 |
| 1,000 – 5,000 | $0.0009 (-10%) |
| 5,000 – 10,000 | $0.0008 (-20%) |
| 10,000 – 20,000 | $0.0007 (-30%) |
| 20,000 – 30,000 | $0.0006 (-40%) |
| 30,000+ | $0.0005 (-50%) |

Volume discounts are calculated daily and applied automatically.

### Free Tier
- $0.05 free credit (~50 requests) for new accounts, granted once per user
- Access to test endpoints across all platforms
- No credit card required

### Enterprise
- Minimum: $3,000 one-time or $4,500 cumulative spend
- Custom endpoints, dedicated support, permanent fee waivers, bonus credits
- 3–10% bonus credits on every purchase
- B2B bank transfer available for established enterprise customers

### Payment Methods
- PayPal (guest checkout supported, no PayPal account required)
- Alipay (daily limit $250; contact us for higher limits)
- USDT (send the displayed amount plus network gas fee)

### REST API
Compatible with any HTTP client in any programming language.

### Workflow Automation
- Zapier and n8n integrations with 28 ready-made actions
- Webhooks and scheduled runs supported

## Common Use Cases

1. **AI Training Data**: Social reasoning and emotional-intelligence datasets for model training and fine-tuning
2. **AI Agents**: Real-time social data tools for agents via MCP — quantitative trading signals, monitoring, research
3. **Social Media Analytics**: Track engagement metrics, follower growth, content performance
4. **Influencer Marketing**: Discover influencers, analyze audiences, measure ROI
5. **Content Intelligence**: Monitor trends, analyze viral content patterns
6. **Academic Research**: Collect public data for social media studies, sentiment analysis
7. **E-commerce Monitoring**: Track TikTok Shop products, social commerce trends
8. **Brand Monitoring**: Track brand mentions, sentiment, competitor activity

## Technical Requirements

- HTTPS required for all API calls
- JSON request/response format
- UTF-8 encoding
- API key required (obtain at https://user.tikhub.io/dashboard/api after registering at https://user.tikhub.io/register)
